assets.prompt: Create ONE educational illustration, a separate cutout asset. Fine charcoal ink contours with restrained layered watercolour and realistic object/anatomy proportions. Match an editorial natural-history teaching collection. TRUE transparent alpha outside the object, no painted paper rectangle, no checkerboard. Keep roughly 12% clear transparent margins on every side. No people, human hands, human faces, brands or labels. Include text, numbers or arrows only if the individual asset brief explicitly requires them. Animal heads are essential where appropriate. Preserve the requested view and approximate aspect ratio. No cast shadow or floor unless explicitly requested. ASSET BRIEF: EDIT referenced shoe and wall calendar. Correct calendar grid to EXACTLY SEVEN equal day columns and FIVE week rows, thin horizontal and vertical lines. Three short runs of ticks at the first three cells in each of the first three week rows; remaining squares empty. Blank header no numbers or text. Keep shoe, palette, framing and transparent background unchanged.
assets.scope: HMS Module 1 or Module 2 v01-v08 only
